name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 24, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR Public comments regarding consent calendar items on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov.
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 10, 2020 Special Meeting, and June 10, 2020 Regular Meeting Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-06-24 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Acting Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-06-24 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Authorization to procure Dell computer hardware. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
1) Authorize the procurement of Dell computer hardware in an amount of $74,510 in FY 2020-21 using the NASPO ValuePoint (MNWNC-108) California Participating Addendum No 7-15-70-34-003 contract pricing; and 2) Authorize participation in the NASPO Valuepoint (MNWNC-108) California Participating Addendum No 7-15-70-34-003 in a total amount not to exceed $371,372 for the term April 1, 2017 to July 31, 2021.
2020-06-24 Item 08C Authorization to Procure Dell Computer Hardware
8D.
Authorization to procure Hewlett Packard (HP) servers, data storage, and to renew support and maintenance on existing hardware. Contact Person: It Operations Supervisor Contreras
1) Authorize the procurement of HP hardware purchases and annual support renewals in an amount of $114,245 in FY 2020-21 using NASPO ValuePoint (MNWNC-115/MNNVP-134) California Participating Addendum No 7-15-70-34-002 contract pricing; and 2) Authorize participation in NASPO ValuePoint (MNWNC-115/MNNVP-134) California Participating Addendum No 7-15-70-34-002 in a total amount not to exceed $399,740 for the period of July 1, 2017 through July 31, 2021.
2020-06-24 Item 08D Authorization to Procure HP Servers, Data Storage and Support
8E.
Annual Weed Abatement Lien List for Property Owners Who Have Not Paid for Removal of Hazardous Weeds and Authorize the Fire Prevention Bureau to Transmit List to the County of San Diego. Contact Person: Fire Marshal Schmidt
Approve the annual weed abatement lien list and authorize the Fire Prevention Bureau to deliver the list to the County of San Diego.
2020-06-24 Item 08E Weed Abatement Lien List
8F.
Commission for the Arts Work Plan Outcomes for FY 2019-2020 and Proposed Work Plan for FY 2020-2021. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
1) Receive the final report outcomes for FY 2019-2020 Commission for the Arts Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2020-2021 Commission for the Arts Work Plan.
2020-06-24 Item 08F Commission for the Arts Work Plan
8G.
Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan outcomes for FY 2019-20 and proposed work plan for FY 2020-21. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) Receive final report outcomes regarding the FY 2019-20 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2020-21 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan.
2020-06-24 Item 08G Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan
8H.
Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan Outcomes for Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Proposed Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2020-21. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
1) Receive final reported outcomes for the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2020-21 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan
2020-06-24 Item 08H Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan
8I.
Acceptance of FY 2020-25 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing Choice. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 2020-49 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the FY 2020-25 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing Choice (AI), and Authorizing the City Manager or Designee to Execute Associated Documents and Certifications.”
2020-06-24 Item 08I Fair Housing Analysis
8J.
Ratification of a letter sent in support for an NCTD grant application. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the attached letters of support for the San Diego Convention Center Freight and Passenger Rail Improvement Project grant application for the Federal Railroad Administration’s Consolidated Rail Infrastructure and Safety Improvements (CRISI) Program.
2020-06-24 Item 08J SANDAG CRISI Grant Support
8K.
*Public Hearing to Consider a Substantial Amendment to the City’s FY 2019-20 Annual Action Plan and Citizen and Community Participation Plan to address program waivers and additional funding in response to the global Coronavirus Pandemic (COVID-19). Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-42 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas approving a Substantial Amendment to Citizen and Community Participation Plan, a Substantial Amendment to the FY 2019-20 Annual Action Plan, and authorizing the City Manager, or designee, to execute all documents and contracts consistent with the amended FY 2019-20 Action Plan, and submission of the amended plans to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD);” 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-43 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget;” and 3) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute a contract amendment with Jeda Works dba Housing Programs not to exceed $227,647 for a Rental and Utility Assistance Program.
2020-06-24 Item 08K CDBG Substantial Amendement COVID
8L.
Memorandum of Understanding for homelessness services in an amount not-to-exceed $237,500 with Community Resource Center (CRC) for the use of the District 76 Homeless Prevention and Intervention Funds (HPIF) received from the State Housing Community and Development for specific homelessness prevention and intervention services in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Approve the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Community Resource Center, in an amount not to exceed $237,500, and authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute the agreement, including any amendments and time extensions, in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney.
2020-06-24 Item 08L MOU with CRC - District 76 Funds
8M.
Approval of FY 2020-21 Operating Budget and Capital Improvement Program (CIP) with Appropriations and Adoption of Resolution No. 2020-54; Adoption of Resolution 2020-55, Determination of the Appropriations Limit for FY 2020-21; and Adoption of Resolution 2020-56, Approval of Position Titles and Pay Ranges for FY 2020-21.
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-54, approving the City of Encinitas FY 2020-21 Operating Budget and CIP Appropriations; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-55, determining the FY 2020-21 Appropriations Limit; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-56, approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for the City of Encinitas for FY 2020-21.
2020-06-24 Item 08M Budget Adoption
8N.
Extension of the Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency and Memorandum of Understanding with Community Resource Center for the Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Program for the COVID-19 response for emergency non-congregate sheltering to October 31, 2020. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Authorize the City Manager to approve, in substantial form, as attached, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney of the extension of the Amendment to the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego to provide up to 22 hotel rooms for “high-risk” individuals that are experiencing homelessness during the COVID-19 pandemic for a period up to October 31, 2020; and 2) If the amendment to the County MOA is approved, authorize the City Manager to approve, in substantial form, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney the amendment to the existing Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Community Resource Center (CRC) to provide case management services for the “high-risk” individuals utilizing the temporary lodging, that are not participating in Opening Doors or the Homeless Prevention and Intervention Fund programs, at a cost not-to-exceed $14,000 (10% of lodging costs for administrative fee) for an extended period from August 1,2020 to October 31, 2020.
2020-06-24 Item 08N Motel Voucher Program - MOA
8O.
Reauthorization of the Opening Doors Program for FY 2020-21. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Review the fourth year (FY 2019-20) results to date of the Opening Doors Program; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center (CRC), in an amount no to exceed $118,700, for implementation of the fifth year of the Opening Doors Program in the City of Encinitas in substantial form, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney.
2020-06-24 Item 08O Opening Doors Reauthorization for FY 2020-21
8P.
Agreement with JPW Communications, LLC for communication support services. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Authorize the Interim City Manager to execute a one-year agreement with two optional one-year extensions in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney for JPW Communications, LLC (JPW) to provide communications services for the City in the not to exceed amount of $154,545.
2020-06-24 Item 08P JPW Communications Agreement
8Q.
Annual Citywide Pavement Resurfacing Project (CS20A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
It is recommended that City Council approve the project list of streets and specifications.
2020-06-24 Item 08Q Annual Citywide Paving Resurfacing Project (CS20A)
8R.
Construction Contract for City Hall Improvements – Phase One (CF20C). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Authorize the Interim City Manager, or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form with Firestone Builders in the amount of $689,010 plus a ten percent contingency of $68,901, for a total project amount not to exceed $757,911; 2) Authorize purchase of carpet in the amount of $141,452; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2020-57 Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget.
2020-06-24 Item 08R City Hall Improvements
8S.
Authorize application for rehabilitation funding for the South Coast Highway 101 Bridge over the San Elijo Lagoon under the Highway Bridge Program. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to apply for, accept and administer federal funding from the Highway Bridge Program (HBP) for the San Elijo Bridge Rehabilitation project.
2020-06-24 Item 08S Bridge Report
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Public comments regarding items not listed on this agenda (oral communications) must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public comments regarding Action Items listed on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
10A.
Public Hearing and Consideration of Resolution 2020-46 Approving Solid Waste Collection Rates. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Conduct a Public Hearing on a rate increase for solid waste collection services; and 2) If the final tabulation of written protest votes does not represent a majority of property owners/customers, adopt Resolution 2020-46 approving solid waste collection rates.
2020-06-24 Item 10A Prop 218 for Trash Rates
10B.
Review of the data and information collected and provide direction on proposed strategies for the Homeless Action Plan. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Discuss information collected and potential strategies for the Homeless Action Plan and provide direction to staff on the plan.
2020-06-24 Item 10B Homeless Action Plan
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THERE IS A SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING ON JUNE 29, 2020. THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 12, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
